functions: Talking about past actions (Spreadsheets and formulae)
Explaining sequences of system administration tasks (Systems administration)
grammarFocus: Past simple for finished actions in the past; did/didn't + bare infinitive in questions and negative sentences; irregular past forms (found, chose, went)
By + -ing to express how to do things: By running a report, we can print a list of customers.
While, before, after to show the order of events; -ing form after these words when the subject is the same in both clauses
Past continuous and past simple: past continuous for the longer action in progress, past simple for the shorter action that interrupts it; when + past simple, while + past continuous
sourceNotes: Reading R1–R20 dựa trên đề mẫu Unit 4 bản email Peter (ảnh -uoNarV2.jpeg, AzrG2XY6.jpeg). Câu dịch W31–W35 và đề email cho Peter lấy từ ảnh lEUhLyPn.jpeg.
R1–R5: giữ nguyên thuật ngữ và định nghĩa của đề mẫu; định nghĩa B sửa "a large number" thành "a larger number" cho đúng Workbook.
R19: câu đề mẫu hỏi lại thuật ngữ câu nối 5 và dùng thuật ngữ câu nối 2; viết lại với thiết bị ngoại vi khác của Workbook 4B.

R7: thay bằng tình huống khác vẫn kiểm before + -ing (bản r1); bản r2 chuyển sang chọn dạng động từ sau before để chỉ một phương án đúng ngữ pháp.
R8: câu đề mẫu trùng tình huống với gạch đầu dòng cuối của email Peter; đổi tình huống. R10: câu đề mẫu trùng tình huống câu dịch W32; đổi tình huống. R9: bỏ từ gần thuật ngữ câu nối 3.

R6: đổi lời để không chép ví dụ trong Language box của giáo trình. R11: đổi tình huống. R13: chỉnh lời. R16: thay một phương án nhiễu có thể hiểu là đúng. R17: viết lại để không dùng lại từ khoá định nghĩa của câu nối 3.
Thứ tự phương án R6–R25 được xếp lại so với đề mẫu.

Áp dụng quy tắc 11–15 (main c59c818): Listening B bỏ câu tìm bản ghi bằng ô tìm kiếm (gần định nghĩa câu nối 3); bài đọc R26–R30 thêm câu khẳng định hoặc phủ định trực tiếp cho R26–R28, viết lại R28 và R30; đề email nêu rõ phải dùng before/after + -ing và by + -ing; S1 thay câu 2 và cả ba câu S1 cùng đề S3 nêu rõ cấu trúc cần dùng; sourceNotes bỏ mọi thông tin đáp án.

Email theo khung giáo viên (2026-10-14): email hướng dẫn From/To/Date/Subject, It should be quite easy to…, First/Then/Next/After that/Finally, Don't forget to… when you've finished, Best wishes + chữ ký 3 dòng.

parts.instructions: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer A, B, C or D (Questions L1–L5).
parts.context: Sofia, an IT manager, has just come back from a conference. She asks Ben, her assistant, what happened while she was away.

script.speaker: Sofia
script.text: Hi Ben, I'm back! How did everything go while I was at the conference?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Quite well, thanks. There weren't any big problems.

script.speaker: Sofia
script.text: Good. Did you deploy the update to the accounting software?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes, I deployed it on Wednesday evening, after everyone went home. It went smoothly on almost every computer.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: One laptop in the sales office was switched off, so it didn't get the update. I installed it the next morning before the sales manager arrived.

script.speaker: Sofia
script.text: Fine. What about the new interns in the finance department?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I set their permissions on Monday. They have read-only access to the finance folder, so they can open the files, but they can't change them.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Just one. While I was updating the antivirus software on Friday, the system sent me an alert. Someone tried to log in to the director's account forty times during the night.

script.speaker: Sofia
script.text: Forty times! What did you do?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I blocked that IP address straight away and sent a message to the director.

script.speaker: Sofia
script.text: Well done. I'll talk to our security company this afternoon. Before I do that, could you send me a copy of the alert?

questions.stem: When did Ben deploy the update to the accounting software?
questions.explanation: Ben nói "I deployed it on Wednesday evening, after everyone went home". Thứ Hai là ngày cài quyền cho thực tập sinh, thứ Sáu là ngày cập nhật phần mềm diệt virus.

questions.stem: Why didn't one laptop get the update?

options.text: The sales manager took it home.
It was in the server room.

questions.explanation: "One laptop in the sales office was switched off, so it didn't get the update." Ben cài lại vào sáng hôm sau.

questions.stem: What can the interns do with the files in the finance folder?

options.text: Open them but not change them
Copy them to a memory stick

questions.explanation: Thực tập sinh có "read-only access" (quyền chỉ đọc): "they can open the files, but they can't change them".

questions.stem: What happened while Ben was updating the antivirus software?

options.text: The email server was very slow.
He got an alert about many login attempts.
An intern opened the director's account.

questions.explanation: Trong lúc Ben đang cập nhật phần mềm diệt virus, hệ thống gửi cảnh báo: có người "tried to log in to the director's account forty times during the night" (cố đăng nhập 40 lần trong đêm).

questions.stem: What does Sofia ask Ben to do?

options.text: Send her a copy of the alert

questions.explanation: Sofia hỏi "could you send me a copy of the alert?". Chính Sofia sẽ nói chuyện với công ty bảo mật (A sai).

parts.instructions: Listen to the talk and answer the questions. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer (Questions L6–L10).
parts.context: Helen, the database administrator at a dental clinic, explains the patient database to new receptionists.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: Good morning, and welcome to Riverside Dental Clinic. I'm Helen, the database administrator. Before you start work at reception, I'd like to show you how our patient database works.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: The database has three tables: Patients, Appointments and Treatments. Each record in the Patients table holds information about one person, such as given name, family name, date of birth and phone number. Many patients have the same family name, so we give each person a unique patient number. That field is the primary key.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: You add new patients by using the New Patient form. Please don't type information straight into the tables, because it's easy to make mistakes there. When a patient changes their phone number, please update their record on the same day, because we send appointment reminders by text message.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: Every evening, before you go home, please print the list of tomorrow's appointments by running the Daily Diary report. Last month a receptionist forgot to do this, and the next morning nobody knew which patients were coming in.

questions.stem: How many tables does the database have?
questions.explanation: Helen nói "The database has three tables: Patients, Appointments and Treatments".

questions.stem: Which field is the primary key in the Patients table?
questions.explanation: Vì nhiều bệnh nhân trùng họ, mỗi người có một mã bệnh nhân riêng: "a unique patient number. That field is the primary key."

questions.stem: What should receptionists use to add new patients?
questions.explanation: "You add new patients by using the New Patient form." Helen dặn không gõ thẳng vào bảng (tables).

questions.stem: When should receptionists print the list of tomorrow's appointments?
questions.explanation: "Every evening, before you go home, please print the list of tomorrow's appointments".

questions.stem: Which report prints the list of tomorrow's appointments?
questions.explanation: Danh sách lịch hẹn ngày mai được in "by running the Daily Diary report".

matching.instructions: Match the terms (1–5) with the correct definitions (A–F). There is one extra definition that you do not need (Questions 1–5).

definitions.text: To ask a question about the data stored in a computer system, in order to retrieve some information.
To take (a number or an amount) from a larger number or amount.
A device that allows you to draw on its surface, using a stylus rather than a mouse, with the results appearing on your computer screen.
An occasion when a computer or a computer system suddenly stops working.
The art of combining pictures, words and decoration in the production of books, magazines, etc.
A thing shaped like a pen, used for writing on a special computer screen.

items.explanation: Crash (sự cố treo, sập) là khi máy tính hoặc hệ thống máy tính đột ngột ngừng hoạt động.
Stylus là bút cảm ứng, vật có hình dạng như cây bút, dùng để viết trên màn hình máy tính đặc biệt.
Query the database (truy vấn cơ sở dữ liệu) là đặt câu hỏi về dữ liệu lưu trong hệ thống để lấy ra thông tin cần thiết.
Subtract (trừ) là lấy một số hoặc một lượng ra khỏi một số hoặc lượng lớn hơn.

Graphics tablet (bảng vẽ đồ hoạ) là thiết bị cho phép vẽ trên bề mặt của nó bằng bút stylus thay cho chuột, kết quả hiện trên màn hình. Định nghĩa E là của graphic design (thiết kế đồ hoạ), không có trong danh sách thuật ngữ.

grammar.stem: Did you ______ the sales figures in the spreadsheet and ______ any errors?
grammar.explanation: Câu hỏi thì quá khứ đơn: Did + chủ ngữ + động từ nguyên mẫu. Cả hai động từ sau "Did you" đều để nguyên mẫu: check, find.

grammar.stem: Before ______ the keyboard, always switch off and unplug the computer.
grammar.explanation: Khi hai vế cùng chủ ngữ (bạn lau bàn phím, bạn tắt máy), sau "before" dùng V-ing: "Before cleaning …". "before" là giới từ nên không đi với động từ nguyên mẫu, quá khứ phân từ hay to-infinitive.

grammar.stem: After ______ the server room, always lock the door.
grammar.explanation: Khi hai vế cùng chủ ngữ (bạn rời phòng, bạn khoá cửa), sau "after" dùng V-ing: "After leaving …".

grammar.stem: ______ a report in the database, you can see last month's total sales.
grammar.explanation: Diễn tả cách làm một việc dùng "by + V-ing": "By running a report" (bằng cách chạy một báo cáo). Sau giới từ "by" phải dùng V-ing, không dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

grammar.stem: By ______ a filter on the Date column, you can see only this month's orders.
grammar.explanation: Sau giới từ "by" dùng V-ing: "By using a filter …" (bằng cách dùng bộ lọc).

grammar.stem: The technician found an error in the network settings and ______ it straight away.
grammar.explanation: Hai hành động nối tiếp đã xong trong quá khứ, nối bằng "and": found … and corrected (quá khứ đơn, động từ có quy tắc thêm -ed).

grammar.stem: While the technicians ______ the network drives, the power suddenly went off.
grammar.explanation: Hành động dài đang diễn ra (quá khứ tiếp diễn sau "while") thì bị hành động ngắn xen vào (went off, quá khứ đơn). Chủ ngữ "the technicians" số nhiều nên dùng "were checking".

vocabulary.stem: In a spreadsheet, a horizontal line of cells that goes across the page is called a ______.
vocabulary.explanation: Row (hàng) là dãy ô nằm ngang. Column (cột) là dãy ô theo chiều dọc.

vocabulary.stem: In a database table, a ______ is a single field that uniquely identifies each record, such as a staff ID number.
vocabulary.explanation: Primary key (khoá chính) là trường xác định duy nhất mỗi bản ghi trong bảng, ví dụ mã nhân viên.

vocabulary.stem: Which database object is used as an interface for users to enter data into tables easily?
vocabulary.explanation: Form (biểu mẫu) là đối tượng giúp nhập dữ liệu vào bảng dễ dàng. Report dùng để in kết quả; record là một bản ghi và field là một trường trong bảng, không phải giao diện nhập liệu.

vocabulary.stem: When an IT administrator decides who can open or change specific files and folders on a server, they are setting ______.
vocabulary.explanation: Permissions (quyền truy cập) là thiết lập cho biết ai được dùng, mở hay sửa tệp và thư mục. Cụm "set permissions" có trong bài Systems administration.

vocabulary.stem: A systems administrator reads the ______ to see a record of events on the server, for example who logged in and when.
vocabulary.explanation: Log (nhật ký hệ thống) là bản ghi chính thức các sự kiện, ví dụ ai đăng nhập lúc nào.

vocabulary.stem: A ______ is a collection of hard drives in a single box accessed through a network, providing flexible storage for all connected computers.
vocabulary.explanation: NAS (Network Attached Storage) device là bộ nhiều ổ cứng trong một hộp, truy cập qua mạng để các máy tính cùng lưu trữ.

vocabulary.stem: Which part of a laptop do you slide your finger across to move the cursor instead of using a mouse?
vocabulary.explanation: Touchpad (bàn di chuột cảm ứng) là bộ phận của laptop dùng ngón tay để di chuyển con trỏ thay cho chuột.

vocabulary.stem: When paper gets stuck inside a printer and stops it from printing, this common problem is called a paper ______.
vocabulary.explanation: Paper jam (kẹt giấy) là khi giấy bị kẹt trong máy in khiến máy không in được.

passageMcq.instructions: Read the passage and choose the best answer A, B, C or D (Questions 21–25).

passage.title: A Better Way to Count the Bread
paragraphs: Last year, Maria Lopez ran a small bakery with two shops in the same town. Every evening, she wrote the day's sales in a notebook and added up the numbers with a calculator. The work took about an hour, and she often made mistakes when she was tired.

In January, her nephew Daniel, an IT student, offered to help. He designed a spreadsheet with one worksheet for each shop. In each worksheet, column A showed the products, column B showed the price and column C showed the number of items sold. Then he typed a formula into column D that multiplied the price by the number of items. At the bottom of column D, a SUM function added all the values together and showed the total for the day.

At first, Maria did not trust the spreadsheet. For two weeks, she checked every total with her calculator. She found only one problem: Daniel chose the wrong cells in one formula, so the total for the second shop did not include the cakes. He corrected it the same day, and after that the totals were always right.

Now Maria saves almost an hour every evening. By comparing the two worksheets, she can also see which products sell better in each shop. Last month, she stopped making brown bread for the second shop because very few customers bought it there. She used the extra time and money to try new kinds of cakes.

questions.stem: What was Maria's problem before January?

options.text: She often made mistakes in her sums.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: Maria cộng doanh số bằng tay và máy tính bỏ túi, mất khoảng một giờ và "often made mistakes when she was tired".

questions.stem: What did the formula in column D do?

options.text: It added the prices of all the products.
It divided the total by the two shops.
It multiplied the price by the items sold.
It showed the name of each product.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: "a formula into column D that multiplied the price by the number of items". Việc cộng tất cả giá trị là của hàm SUM ở cuối cột D.

questions.stem: Why did Maria check every total with her calculator for two weeks?

options.text: She did not trust the spreadsheet at first.
Daniel asked her to test his formulae.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "At first, Maria did not trust the spreadsheet. For two weeks, she checked every total with her calculator."

questions.stem: What was wrong with one of Daniel's formulae?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "Daniel chose the wrong cells in one formula", nên tổng của cửa hàng thứ hai thiếu bánh ngọt (không phải tính hai lần).

questions.stem: What did Maria do after comparing the two worksheets?

options.text: She stopped making brown bread for one shop.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: "she stopped making brown bread for the second shop because very few customers bought it there".

passageTrueFalse.instructions: Read the passage and write T (True) or F (False) (Questions 26–30).

passage.title: Problems in the Training Room
paragraphs: Last Tuesday was a difficult day in the training room at Fenwick Insurance. At nine o'clock in the morning, Tom Hale, a trainer, was setting up the projector for a course on the new booking system when the screen suddenly went blue. While he was checking the settings, a technician arrived. She found that the projector was working correctly, but someone had connected it with the wrong cable. She replaced it, and the course started fifteen minutes late.

In the afternoon, the trainees were taking part in an online meeting with the head office. While they were listening to the finance director, the sound in two headsets stopped. The technician discovered that the headsets were plugged into a broken USB hub. She connected them straight to the computers, and the sound came back after a few minutes.

After the course, Tom wrote a short report for the IT department. He asked them to put labels on all the projector cables and to test the headsets every Monday morning, before the first course of the week.

questions.statement: The problem with the projector happened in the morning.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: sự cố máy chiếu xảy ra "At nine o'clock in the morning".

questions.statement: The technician found that the projector was broken.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: kỹ thuật viên thấy "the projector was working correctly" (máy chiếu vẫn hoạt động bình thường); lỗi là do ai đó dùng sai cáp.
Đoạn 1: khoá học bắt đầu muộn 15 phút ("started fifteen minutes late").

questions.statement: The trainees were listening to the finance director when the sound stopped.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: "While they were listening to the finance director, the sound in two headsets stopped."

questions.statement: Tom asked the IT department to test the headsets every Monday.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: Tom đề nghị phòng IT "test the headsets every Monday morning".

items.source: Nero Burning ROM is a professional software solution for burning audio, data, and image files onto optical discs.
items.referenceTranslation: Nero Burning ROM là một giải pháp phần mềm chuyên nghiệp để ghi các tệp âm thanh, dữ liệu và hình ảnh lên đĩa quang.

items.source: When I typed the date into this spreadsheet cell, it came out as a number instead of a proper date format.
items.referenceTranslation: Khi tôi gõ ngày vào ô bảng tính này, nó lại hiện ra thành một con số thay vì đúng định dạng ngày.

items.source: Each record in a client database is like a row on a spreadsheet, while each field functions like an individual cell.
items.referenceTranslation: Mỗi bản ghi trong cơ sở dữ liệu khách hàng giống như một hàng trên bảng tính, còn mỗi trường có chức năng như một ô riêng lẻ.

items.source: While the systems administrator was checking the server logs for system errors, the main network drive crashed.
items.referenceTranslation: Trong khi quản trị viên hệ thống đang kiểm tra nhật ký máy chủ để tìm lỗi hệ thống thì ổ đĩa mạng chính bị sập.

items.source: Before reinstalling the operating system or replacing the hard drive, make sure to back up all important data to an external NAS device.
items.referenceTranslation: Trước khi cài đặt lại hệ điều hành hoặc thay ổ cứng, hãy nhớ sao lưu toàn bộ dữ liệu quan trọng sang một thiết bị NAS bên ngoài.

email.task:
Write an email to your user called Peter to instruct him about how to prepare his system before a major software upgrade and resolve an account login issue. Use the notes below. In your email you must use:
- before or after + -ing at least twice to show the order of the steps (Before deploying…, After setting…);
- by + -ing at least once to explain how to do something (You can … by selecting…).
Follow the standard layout for an email giving instructions: From / To / Date / Subject, a greeting, It should be quite easy to …, the steps with First / Then / Next / After that / Finally, a reminder (Don't forget to … when you've finished.), then Best wishes and your name, position and department.
Write 80–100 words (do not count the From, To, Date and Subject lines).
bullets: back up database files / transfer them to NAS device
check system logs / verify network connections
deploy major software upgrade / restart computer
open login page / select "Reset Password" if account is locked
set new password / log in to confirm new credentials work
targetGrammar: Before / after + -ing (at least twice) to show the order of tasks: Before deploying the upgrade, …; After setting a new password, …
Imperatives with sequence words (first, then, next, after that, finally)
By + -ing (at least once) to explain how to do something: by selecting "Reset Password"
email.modelAnswer:
From: Pham Thu Ha
To: Peter
Date: 25th November
Subject: Preparing for the software upgrade

Hi Peter,

It should be quite easy to prepare your system for the upgrade.
First, back up the database files and transfer them to the NAS device.
Then, before deploying the upgrade, check the system logs and network connections.
Next, deploy the upgrade and restart your computer.
After that, open the login page. You can unlock your account by selecting "Reset Password".
Finally, after setting a new password, log in to confirm that it works.
Don't forget to log out of the NAS device when you've finished.

Best wishes,
Pham Thu Ha
Support Technician
Help Desk Department

parts.instructions: Answer the three questions. Speak for 30–45 seconds for each question.
questions: What did you use a computer or smartphone for yesterday? Describe two or three things you did. Use the past simple.
What do you do before and after installing a new app on your phone or computer? Use before + -ing and after + -ing (Before installing…, After installing…).
How do you usually find an old file, photo or message quickly on your computer or phone? Answer with by + -ing (by typing…, by searching…).

parts.instructions: Explain the sequence of tasks to a colleague. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: A new IT assistant starts work tomorrow. Explain the steps for setting up a computer for a new employee. Use before, while and after to show the order of the tasks.
cues: check the employee's job and department
create a user account on the server
install the standard software / download the latest updates
set permissions for the shared folders
ask the employee to log in and check that everything works
requiredGrammar: Before + -ing / before + clause: Before creating the account, …
While + clause: While the software is installing, …
After + -ing / after + clause: After installing the updates, …
parts.sampleAnswer: Setting up a computer for a new employee is quite simple if you do things in the right order. Before doing anything else, check the employee's job and department, because this tells you which software and folders they need. Then create a user account for them on the server. After creating the account, install the standard software on the computer. While the software is installing, you can download the latest updates, so you save time. After installing the updates, set the permissions for the shared folders. For example, people in the sales team can open the sales folder but not the HR folder. Finally, before you leave, ask the employee to log in and check that everything works. If there is a problem, you can fix it straight away.

parts.instructions: Deal with the situation. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: You are an IT assistant. Your manager was away yesterday and asks you what happened. Use the cues to explain how the problem occurred and what you did to solve it. Use the past continuous for the action in progress and the past simple for what happened (… was …ing when …; While I was …ing, …).
cues: 10.15 a.m.: the sales team / give an online presentation to a client
the internet connection / drop three times
you / check the router → find a damaged network cable
while you / replace the cable → the sales manager / phone the client
after replacing the cable → test the connection / everything / work
requiredGrammar: Past continuous for the longer action in progress: The sales team was giving a presentation…
Past simple for the shorter action and finished actions: …when the connection dropped.
When + past simple, while + past continuous
parts.sampleAnswer: Yesterday morning we had a problem with the internet connection. At about quarter past ten, the sales team was giving an online presentation to an important client when the connection suddenly dropped. It happened three times in twenty minutes. First, I checked the router, but it was working normally. Then I looked behind the desk and found a damaged network cable. While I was replacing the cable, the sales manager phoned the client and explained the problem. After replacing the cable, I tested the connection for about ten minutes, and everything worked fine. The team finished the presentation at eleven o'clock. I think we should check all the cables in the meeting room next week.
